heading: Content library
body: Courses published by head office. Take a copy and it is yours to edit.
empty_body: Head office has not published a course to the library. Create your own course in the meantime.
preview_body: The outline you will get. Problems come across complete, with their test cases.
title_hint: Change it if you already have a course by this name.
adopted: Copied. It is hidden until you publish it.
customized_hint: You have edited this copy since taking it.
update_hint: Head office has changed this course since you copied it. Take a fresh copy to compare.
retired_hint: Head office has withdrawn this course. Your copy keeps working.
unavailable_heading: The library could not be read
unavailable_body: Reload the page. If it keeps failing, ask your manager whether curriculum editing is available to you.
